About Lucas

Lucas is an internationally trusted and recognised brand, with strong, robust and well-engineered quality products. Lucas parts are distributed in world markets by specialist partners.

One service, three filters. Lucas oil, air and fuel filters are engineered to replace the original parts and protect the engine between services. As a fitter, you can find every filter a vehicle needs here and order them together. Every Lucas filter ships in the Lucas green carton, labelled with its Lucas part number.

Reading the sizes

H / OD
Spin-on filters and round elements: height and outer diameter in mm. Cartridges add the inside diameter (ID).
L x W x H
Panel air filters: length, width and height in mm
Thread
Spin-on filters: thread of the base plate, for example M20 x 1.5 or 3/4-16 UNF
In / Out
In-line petrol fuel filters: inlet and outlet connection

Product pictures show the filter type, not the exact part. Fuel filter pictures are drawings until product photos are supplied. Reference only: applications and cross-references are compiled from manufacturer and aftermarket data. Always compare the old filter's size, thread and seal before fitting.
